_comment: Ready ports that several commands declare on purpose: the commands are variants of one service that bind the same port, so only one runs at a time. Each entry names its reason; an undocumented shared port fails the coverage suite.

portSharing.6010: storybook: dev-storybook and its scoped variants serve one Storybook port
portSharing.6029: mit-bestand demonstrator: dev and serve are one server in two modes
portSharing.6033: semio-tech play: dev and serve are one server in two modes
portSharing.6061: architecture quiz: dev and dev-site are one Vite server on the quiz port
portSharing.6274: MCP inspector: the Nx targets and the tool start the same inspector client port
portSharing.8787: hub: every hub variant owns the single hub port
